title: The Ultimate God Potion
description: Adds a brand-new custom potion to Minecraft! This special potion can only be obtained in Creative Mode, making it a rare and exclusive item for map makers, mod showcases, and creative builders.
body:
Adds a powerful custom potion exclusive to Creative Mode — perfect for adventure maps, showcases, or experimenting with unique effects.

📖 Description

The Ultimate God Potion introduces a brand-new, exclusive potion to Minecraft that’s not obtainable in Survival Mode. Designed for creators, map makers, and curious players, this mod adds a fun and mysterious tool to enhance creative gameplay.

Unlike standard potions, this one offers unique and powerful effects that let you experiment freely without breaking survival balance. It’s ideal for:

🗺️ Adventure and Roleplay Maps – Add a potion with special effects for story-driven gameplay.

🎥 Content Creators – Use it for mod showcases, cinematic scenes, or creative builds.

🧩 Creative Builders – Enhance your world with a new potion type that adds flair and utility.

This lightweight mod focuses on compatibility and simplicity — no complex setup or dependencies required. Just install, enter Creative Mode, and discover the new potion in your inventory.

Features:

Adds a unique, custom “God Potion” item

Only available in Creative Mode

Distinct visual and gameplay effects

Designed to keep Survival gameplay balanced

Environment:

✅ Client & Server (both required) — the potion item is registered as new content.

Bring a spark of divine creativity to your Minecraft world with The Ultimate God Potion!
